name: erp-saas
description: Multi-tenant SaaS ERP (HRM-first) - NestJS + React + TypeORM

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @erp/api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @erp/api && npm run lint -w @erp/web
